description:
**Job Description**
**Join Tsaaro as an Account Manager – Sales**
**Build Relationships. Drive Revenue. Strengthen Client Success.**
 Are you a client\-focused sales professional passionate about building long\-term relationships, driving account growth, and delivering value to customers? Looking for a role where your strategic engagement directly contributes to strengthening cybersecurity and privacy ecosystems?
   

  

 At Tsaaro, we go beyond compliance — we help organizations build trust, strengthen governance, and elevate their security posture. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an
 **Account Manager – Sales** 
 who excels at client retention, upselling, and nurturing strong business partnerships across industries.
   

  

**About Tsaaro**
 At Tsaaro, privacy and security aren’t support functions — they are the heart of our mission. As a specialized data privacy and cybersecurity consulting firm, we empower businesses to build resilient compliance frameworks, enhance governance, and demonstrate digital trust to their customers.
   

  

 Our Account Management team plays a critical role in developing strong customer relationships, ensuring smooth delivery, and identifying new opportunities that align with client needs.
   

  

**Your Role: Account Manager – Sales**
 As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing client accounts end\-to\-end — from onboarding and relationship building to renewals, upselling, and identifying new business opportunities. You will work closely with delivery teams, consulting teams, and leadership to ensure clients receive exceptional service and measurable value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage and grow relationships with existing clients across privacy, cybersecurity, and GRC domains.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring timely communication and issue resolution.
* Understand client needs, business challenges, and industry context to offer relevant Tsaaro solutions.
* Drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across consulting services, training, assessments, and certifications.
* Collaborate with consulting and delivery teams to ensure high\-quality project execution.
* Manage renewals, contract extensions, and account expansions.
* Conduct quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key clients to showcase progress and identify growth potential.
* Track account performance, revenue projections, and client engagement using CRM systems.
* Identify churn risks and implement proactive strategies to strengthen client retention.
* Coordinate with marketing and sales teams to support campaigns and client\-facing initiatives.
* Stay updated on privacy laws, cybersecurity trends, and market developments to add strategic value during client discussions.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related discipline.
* 4–6 years of experience in account management, client success, or B2B sales.
* Proven track record in managing enterprise accounts, renewals, and revenue growth.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Ability to collaborate across teams and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
* Target\-driven, organized, and proactive with a strong ownership mindset.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience working in cybersecurity, data privacy, SaaS, or consulting environments.
* Understanding of GDPR, DPDP Act, CCPA, or global privacy/security frameworks.
* Exposure to consultative, value\-based, or solution\-selling models.
* Strong analytical mindset for understanding client data and account trends.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or sales automation tools.
* Ability to conduct presentations, proposal discussions, and QBRs confidently.


**Benefits**
* Be part of one of India’s fastest\-growing privacy and cybersecurity consulting firms, managing key accounts that drive business impact.
* Gain deep exposure to privacy regulations (GDPR, DPDP Act) and cybersecurity frameworks while working closely with expert consulting teams.
* Opportunity to transition into Senior Account Manager or Account Director roles based on performance.
* Work directly with cross\-functional teams including consulting, legal, GRC, and marketing.
* Transparent, collaborative, and performance\-driven work culture.
* Access to advanced sales training, certification sponsorships, and accelerated career paths.


**From The Tsaaro Team**
 “At Tsaaro, account management isn’t just about renewals — it’s about building trust, enabling client success, and being a strategic partner. As an Account Manager, you’ll play a key role in shaping how organizations adopt privacy and cybersecurity practices.”
   

  

**Ready to Build Client Success and Drive Strategic Growth?**
 Apply now and be part of Tsaaro’s mission to strengthen privacy, governance, and cybersecurity across the globe.

title: Sales Manager – Investor Acquisition
description:
**About Mitti Money** 




 Mitti Money is a prop\-tech\-led fractional real estate co\-investment platform enabling investors to co\-own institutional\-grade Delhi NCR properties without buying an entire asset. Built on the vision “Premium land. Every hand,” the platform lets investors co\-invest from as little as ₹10 lakh, earning through quarterly rental distributions and potential capital appreciation, all backed by property\-level SPV structures, registered ownership documentation, and third\-party due diligence.
 



  





 At a glance: ₹200\+ Cr assets under management, 400\+ co\-owners onboarded, and a platform built around access, income, appreciation, and transparency for first\-time investors, working professionals, seasoned investors, and HNIs/family offices alike.
 



  





 As Mitti Money scales its marketing and brand\-building efforts over the next 6 months, we're building out the sales engine to match — converting the leads this push generates into onboarded, invested co\-owners, and driving revenue growth across the platform.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Sales Manager who will own the last mile of the investor journey — converting leads generated through digital campaigns, influencer content, events, and referrals into paying investors. You'll run the full sales cycle from first conversation to KYC/documentation to funds transfer, while building the relationships and follow\-up discipline needed to grow ticket sizes and repeat investment over time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Lead Conversion \& Pipeline Management** 




 •     Own inbound leads generated through social media, influencer campaigns, webinars, events, and the website — respond promptly and manage them through a structured sales pipeline.
 



 •     Conduct investor consultations (call/video/in\-person) to understand investment goals, risk appetite, and ticket size, and match them to the right opportunity.
 



 •     Guide prospects through property details, structure (SPV/ownership), expected returns, and risk factors clearly and transparently.
 



 •     Maintain and update lead status, follow\-ups, and conversion data in the CRM; ensure no lead goes cold without a documented reason.
 



  





**Customer Acquisition \& Revenue Growth** 




 •     
 **Own monthly and quarterly investor acquisition and AUM growth targets** 
 — number of new co\-owners onboarded and capital deployed.
 



 •     Drive average ticket size upward through informed conversations, cross\-selling across multiple curated opportunities, and repeat investment from existing co\-owners.
 



 •     Coordinate KYC, documentation, and fund transfer processes with investors, ensuring a smooth and compliant onboarding experience.
 



 •     Build a referral pipeline — encourage satisfied investors to refer working professionals, HNIs, and family offices in their network.
 



  





**Events, Webinars \& On\-Ground Engagement** 




 •     Represent Mitti Money at investor meetups, webinars, corporate hub activations, and press/PR events, converting on\-ground interest into qualified leads.
 



 •     Work closely with the marketing team to close the loop — sharing lead quality feedback to sharpen targeting for future campaigns.
 



 •     Support community engagement (Discord/Telegram, AMAs) by fielding investor questions and nudging engaged members toward investment.
 



  





**Reporting \& Collaboration** 




 •     Track and report on lead\-to\-conversion rates, revenue generated, average ticket size, and investor retention/repeat\-investment rates.
 



 •     Share regular pipeline and forecast updates with founders/leadership.
 



 •     Provide structured feedback to marketing on which channels/campaigns are producing the highest\-quality, most convertible leads.
 



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 •     2–6 years of experience in sales, preferably in real estate, wealth management, fintech, or investment products.
 



 •     Track record of owning and hitting revenue/acquisition targets, not just lead generation — comfortable with the full close.
 



 •     Strong consultative selling skills — able to explain investment structures, risk, and returns clearly to non\-expert investors.
 



 •     Comfort with CRM tools and disciplined pipeline hygiene.
 



 •     Willingness to travel locally for events, meetups, and in\-person investor meetings across Delhi NCR.
 



 •     Bonus: existing network among HNIs, family offices, or working professionals in Tier\-1 cities; familiarity with SPV/fractional ownership structures.
 



  





**Success Metrics You'll Own** 




 •     Number of leads converted to onboarded investors (conversion rate).
 



 •     Revenue generated / capital deployed (AUM growth) per month and quarter.
 



 •     Average investment ticket size.
 



 •     Referral\-driven new investor acquisition.
 




 •     
 
 Investor retention and repeat\-investment rate

-

**Company:**

 Internship / Full\-Time Opportunity

 Fixed Stipend \+
 **Performance\-Based Sales Incentives** 



 About Algoaide
 
**Algoaide** 
 is a modern SaaS platform built for the
 **Transport \& Logistics industry** 
 .
 



 We help fleet owners and logistics companies manage their operations, finance, fleet, drivers, customers and other business processes in one platform. We are also building
 **AI\-powered automation** 
 to reduce manual work in logistics.
 



 We are now looking for
 **fresh, energetic and hardworking talent** 
 who wants to build a career in
 **Sales \& Business Development** 
 .
 



 This is a great opportunity for someone who is more interested in
 **earning through performance and incentives** 
 rather than looking only for a high fixed salary.
 


 What You Will Do
 
 You will work directly on the front line of UniZR's sales growth.
 


* Find potential customers in the
 **Transport \& Logistics industry** 
 .
* Make
 **cold calls** 
 to transporters, fleet owners and logistics companies.
* Introduce Algoaide and understand the customer's business problems.
* Generate and qualify sales leads.
* Schedule meetings with potential customers.
* Attend
 **F2F client meetings** 
 with the team and gradually handle meetings independently.
* Demonstrate Algoaide to potential customers after proper product training.
* Follow up with prospects regularly.
* Convert qualified leads into paying customers.
* Maintain lead and follow\-up information in the CRM.
* Work towards monthly sales targets.
* Build relationships with customers and generate referrals.


 The Sales Journey
 
 You will learn and eventually manage the complete process:
 



**Lead Generation → Cold Call → Qualification → Meeting → Demo → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Sale** 



 Who Are We Looking For?
 
 We are specifically looking for
 **fresh talent** 
 , so prior sales experience is
 **not mandatory** 
 .
 



 You could be:
 


* A recent graduate looking for your first opportunity.
* A college student looking for a sales internship.
* Someone with 0–1 year of experience who wants to enter B2B sales.
* Someone who is confident talking to new people.
* Someone who enjoys meeting customers and travelling locally for business meetings.
* Someone who is highly motivated by
 **performance and earning potential** 
 .


 Most Important: Your Attitude
 
 We are not looking for a candidate with a long resume.
 



 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**Hungry to learn.** 




**Comfortable talking to strangers.** 




**Not afraid of rejection.** 




**Hardworking.** 




**Consistent with follow\-ups.** 




**Interested in earning based on performance.** 




**If you can make 50 calls, hear "No" 45 times, and still make the next 5 calls with the same energy — you could be a good fit for this role.** 



 Compensation Model
 
 This role is designed for candidates who are interested in
 **performance\-based earning** 
 .
 



 Because Algoaide is an early\-stage product, the fixed compensation for this position is limited.
 



 We offer:
 



**Small Fixed Stipend \+ Attractive Commission on Successful Sales** 




**The major earning opportunity comes from sales incentives/commission** 
 .
 



 There is
 **no fixed upper limit on incentive earnings** 
 — the more business you generate and close, the more you can earn.
 



 For the right candidate, this can become significantly more rewarding than a traditional fixed\-salary sales role.
 



*The exact incentive structure will be discussed during the interview.* 



 What You Will Learn
 
 This is not just a calling job.
 



 You will learn:
 


* B2B Sales
* Cold Calling
* Lead Generation
* Customer Qualification
* SaaS Product Sales
* Product Demonstration
* Client Communication
* Negotiation
* Closing Techniques
* CRM \& Sales Pipeline Management
* Transport \& Logistics Industry
* AI \& SaaS Business Models



 You will get the opportunity to work directly with the
 **UniZR team and leadership** 
 and understand how a B2B SaaS business is built and sold.
 


 Why Join UniZR?
 
 If you are a fresher, this role can give you something that many entry\-level jobs don't:
 



**Real responsibility. Real customers. Real meetings. Real sales. Real earning potential.** 




**You won't be sitting in an office doing repetitive work all day.** 




**You will be talking to business owners, understanding their problems, presenting technology solutions and learning how to close real B2B deals.** 



 If You Are Looking For
 
 ❌ A job where you only receive a fixed salary
 



 ❌ A role with no targets
 



 ❌ A role where someone constantly follows up with you
 



**This may not be the right opportunity.** 



 If You Are Looking For
 
 ✅ Your first real sales experience
 



 ✅ An opportunity to learn B2B SaaS sales
 



 ✅ Client\-facing experience
 



 ✅ Unlimited performance\-based earning potential
 



 ✅ An opportunity to grow with an early\-stage product
 



 ✅ A role where your performance directly impacts your earnings
 



  





**We would love to meet you.**

title: Tele consultant
description:
About the Company
   

  

 At StudyIn, we believe that the right guidance has the power to change lives. As the world’s most trusted higher education specialist, we’ve helped over 1\.3 million students access study opportunities since 2006, placing them at top universities across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, and Dubai. Our global team of 500\+ professionals spans 40\+ countries worldwide, offering expert counselling, admissions support, visa guidance, and university partnerships.
   

  

 Main Duties \& Scope of the role:
   

  

 Senior Tele\-consultant is an individual contributor role focused on engaging with prospective students through high\-volume outbound calls and multi\-channel communication, including email and WhatsApp. The role involves lead generation, CRM data accuracy, supporting student events, and maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of destinations and offerings. It requires strong communication skills, attention to quality, and the flexibility to work in shifts.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 ● Outbound Calling \& Lead Engagement:
   

 Handle high\-volume outbound calling (minimum 200 calls per day) to connect with potential students understand their interest areas, and generate qualified leads for further counseling.
   

  

 ● Database Management \& Lead Ownership:
   

 Take full accountability for the assigned student database, ensuring consistent and effective communication across all leads to maximize engagement and conversions.
   

  

 ● Multi\-Channel Communication:
   

 Utilize various communication channels including phone calls, emails, and WhatsApp to follow up with prospective students and provide timely information about StudyIn’s services and events.
   

  

 ● Lead Qualification \& Transfer Process:
   

 Accurately qualify leads and follow the defined protocols for seamless handover to the counseling team, ensuring high\-quality and conversion\-ready leads.
   

  

 ● CRM Accuracy \& Data Hygiene:
   

 Ensure accurate data entry and maintenance of student interactions, follow\-ups, and status updates in the CRM system in real\-time, adhering to quality and compliance standards.
   

  

 ● Event Support \& Promotions:
   

 Assist in promotional calling campaigns for education fairs, seminars, and other marketing events to ensure maximum participation and awareness.
   

  

 ● Reporting \& Documentation:
   

 Prepare and submit daily/weekly reports on call activity, lead status, and follow\-up outcomes as per management requirements.
   

  

 ● Product Knowledge \& Training:
   

 Regularly update your understanding of StudyIn’s program offerings, destinations (e.g., UK, Dubai, ANZ,USA,Canada), and admission processes to effectively communicate with prospective students.
   

  

 About the Candidate (including required competencies):
   

  

 ● Good command over English (Spoken \& Written)
   

  

 ● Probing capabilities and quality work mindset
   

  

 ● Conviction \& Confident
   

  

 ● Flexible to work in shifts within the 9:00 AM – 8:30 PM window (9 hours/day, 5 days/week), with weekly off aligned to business requirements
   

  

 ● Proficient in MS Office applications
   

 Requirements \& Qualification.
   

  

 ● Bachelor’s degree or above in any subject
   

  

 ● Work experience of 2\-5 years in a BPO/Call Centre environment would be a plus.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

 • New Lead to MQL conversion
   

 • Connectivity rate
   

 • Call volume
   

 • Call quality score
   

 • Time to first attempt

description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**
 Dolby is looking for an individual to grow our direct sales revenue from Key accounts in Consumer Electronics (Airtel, Tata, Dixon, Videotex, boat, Channelplay) and Automotive (Maruti Suzuki, JSW MG Motor, Hyundai Motor) businesses in India. We provide audio and imaging solutions to designers and manufacturers of auto, home \& mobile entertainment devices like TVs, Set\-top boxes (STBs), Digital Media Adapters (DMAs), soundbars, AVRs, wireless speakers, Mobiles, Tabs, TWS, In\-car entertainment and to providers of ICs and Operating Systems that drive these devices. These solutions allow device manufacturers to create compelling products for consumers that can participate in the content ecosystems that Dolby builds.
   

  

 Success in this role is defined as maximizing the direct revenue of Dolby technologies with key local accounts.
   

  

**SCOPE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* This role will focus on driving revenue growth through successful adoption of Dolby technologies by consumer electronics manufacturers (OEMs) \& Automotive accounts in India, operating at both technical and commercial level.
* Establish account plans for the key accounts and growing deep business relationships and engagement.
* Develop and effectively manage the customer pipeline.
* The role also requires having to work with Dolby’s technical teams to ensure delivery of systems support to customers to enable them to implement, test, certify, manufacture \& deploy devices supporting Dolby’s technologies.
* Dolby’s predominant business model, in Consumer \& Automotive Entertainment, is one of creating great entertainment experiences, building an ecosystem that delivers those experiences and then monetizing primarily through licensing technologies into Cars \& consumer electronic devices.
* You will be collaborating with the content ecosystem teams and with other key functions (Marketing, Sales operations support, Finance, Legal, IP protection) to deliver value to the customer and grow the Dolby business.
* You will need to understand and follow key licensing application procedures, work with licensing applicants, create and use reports in Salesforce, BI etc.
* Support pre\-sales activity delivering presentations, promoting the value proposition of Dolby technologies to potential partners.
* Participate in tradeshows, industry conferences and other relevant events to create a network of supporters and partners.


**EXPERIENCE:**
* 10\-15 years of relevant industry experience in sales; experience working in a multinational company would be an advantage.
* Bachelor/Master’s degree or equivalent in Science/ Engineering/ Business
* Strong existing network in the Indian Consumer electronics \& Automotive industry will be a key advantage.
* Experience in a technology or IP company preferred.


**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES:**
* A track record of accomplishing measurable and identifiable results.
* Good interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills.
* Strong analytical skills and process orientation.
* Flexibility in a versatile business environment.
* Ability to be proactive, work on own initiative, to deadlines, as well as being able to work as a member of a small but dynamic team.

* A demonstrated record of personally closing mid\-market or enterprise deals.
* Experience owning a sales quota and consistently working towards revenue targets.
* Experience managing sales cycles of 30–90 days or longer.
* Strong experience in both outbound prospecting and deal closure.
* Ability to conduct discovery, product demonstrations, commercial discussions and negotiations independently.
* Experience engaging founders, CXOs and senior functional leaders.
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting and CRM discipline.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel for important customer meetings when required.

**Good\-to\-Have Experience** 



* Experience selling AI\-led business solutions, CRM platforms, communication platforms or workflow automation products.
* Experience selling connected platforms involving more than one product or business function.
* Exposure to multi\-stakeholder enterprise buying processes.
* Familiarity with consultative, solution\-selling or value\-based sales frameworks.
* Experience working with product and implementation teams on customised customer requirements.
* Existing relationships within any of FoxSuite’s priority industries.



  





**Who This Role Is Not Suitable For** 




 This role will not be suitable for:
 


* Candidates whose experience is primarily in retail, showroom or counter sales.
* Profiles without verifiable experience in closing B2B SaaS or enterprise technology deals.
* Candidates whose experience is limited to account management, customer support or relationship servicing.
* Lead\-generation profiles that have not personally managed discovery, negotiation and closure.
* Pure field\-sales profiles without structured SaaS or technology\-selling experience.
* Candidates who depend entirely on inbound leads and do not have hands\-on outbound prospecting experience.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The successful consultant will build a healthy target\-account pipeline, create qualified CXO conversations, maintain disciplined sales execution and convert appropriate opportunities into paid FoxSuite customers.
 



  





 This role is for a salesperson who can open doors, understand complex business requirements, build commercial confidence and take personal ownership of revenue from the first conversation through closure.

title: Sales Intern
description:
**Internship Opportunity: Sales Intern
   

**Company: Adzeek**
 Location: Noida \- Work from Office (with flexibility for sync\-ups)
   

 Duration: 3 months (with potential t** 
 o extend)
   

  

 Are you someone who loves building connections, closing conversations, and turning cold outreach into warm opportunities? Adzeek is looking for a Sales Intern to support our growing pipeline \- from the first touchpoint to the final handshake.
   

  

**About the role:
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated and result\-oriented Sales Executive who can help us grow our client base for performance marketing and digital advertising services.
   

  

 You will be responsible for identifying potential clients, understanding their business and marketing
   

 requirements, pitching relevant solutions, handling sales conversations, and converting qualified leads into clients. The ideal candidate should be confident in communication, comfortable speaking with business owners and decision\-makers, and have a strong interest in digital marketing and sales.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 • Identify and generate new business opportunities through outbound calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn,
   

 referrals, and other relevant channels.
   

 • Research potential clients, their businesses, marketing activities, competitors, and advertising presence to identify sales opportunities.
   

 • Connect with business owners, founders, marketing heads, and decision\-makers to understand their business goals, challenges, and marketing requirements.
   

 • Explain and pitch our performance marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, creative, and digital marketing services based on the client's requirements.
   

 • Conduct discovery calls and sales meetings with prospective clients.
   

 • Prepare and share proposals, quotations, and relevant information with prospective clients.
   

 • Follow up consistently with leads and prospects throughout the sales cycle.
   

 • Handle basic objections related to pricing, results, services, timelines, and competition.
   

 • Maintain an updated pipeline of leads, prospects, follow\-ups, and conversions.
   

 • Coordinate with the performance marketing and creative teams to understand client requirements and prepare relevant pitches.
   

 • Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.
   

 • Maintain strong relationships with existing and newly acquired clients to identify opportunities for upselling and referrals.
   

 • Track and report sales KPIs such as leads contacted, meetings booked, qualified leads, proposals sent, conversion rate, revenue generated, and follow\-ups.
   

  

 Requirements
   

  

 • 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a similar client\-facing role is preferred.
   

 • Experience in selling digital marketing, performance marketing, advertising, SaaS, or other B2B services is a plus.
   

 • Strong communication, negotiation, and convincing skills.
   

 • Comfortable making outbound calls and speaking directly with business owners and decision\-makers.
   

 • Ability to understand a client's business problem and recommend an appropriate marketing solution.
   

 • Target\-oriented mindset with a strong focus on conversions and revenue.
   

 • Good follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
   

 • Basic understanding of digital marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, lead generation, and ROAS is preferred.
   

 • Ability to use Excel/Google Sheets and maintain sales pipeline data.
   

 • Strong ownership, discipline, and willingness to learn.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

 • Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
   

 • Opportunity to earn additional incentives based on sales and revenue performance.
   

 • Hands\-on experience working with real businesses and marketing campaigns.
   

 • Exposure to performance marketing, digital advertising, and client acquisition.
   

 • Fast\-paced work environment with learning and growth opportunities.
   

 • Opportunity to grow into a Senior Sales / Business Development role based on performance.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Share your resume along with details of your previous sales experience, achievements, or relevant projects.
   

 Candidates with experience in digital marketing or B2B sales are encouraged to apply.
   

 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage.**
  

 Let's build a pipeline that converts.

title: Inside Sales Representative
description:
**Company Description** 
 Teknics India Infotech is an established IT solutions provider founded by experienced computer professionals to deliver end\-to\-end hardware and services to small and medium\-sized businesses as well as large enterprises. With more than 28\+ years of expertise in computer peripheral solutions, the company is on a multi\-year journey to expand its presence from a regional to a national level. Teknics India Infotech is driven by the principle of “Make a customer, not a sale,” with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and long\-term partnerships. The company has been recognized as the No.1 partner in South Asia for highest sales growth of GN Netcom – Jabra and awarded EPOS\-Sennheiser BEST PARTNER AWARD 2021 for North India. It has also received a Certification of Appreciation from STMicroelectronics Pvt Ltd for outstanding service and partnership.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Inside Sales Representative role based in Noida. The Inside Sales Representative will handle inbound and outbound calls, qualify leads, and convert prospects into customers through consultative selling. Responsibilities include managing and growing assigned accounts, preparing quotations, following up on proposals, and maintaining accurate records in the CRM. The role involves coordinating with the operations and technical teams to ensure timely delivery and post\-sales support, as well as maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. The Inside Sales Representative will also contribute to sales reporting, forecasting, and meeting individual and team targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Inside Sales and Lead Generation skills focused on B2B hardware or IT solutions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service to build long\-term, trust\-based relationships.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills to nurture existing clients and identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, negotiation, and presentation skills for engaging with diverse stakeholders.
* Relevant experience in IT hardware, peripherals, or technology sales is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, IT, or a related field is beneficial.
* Ability to work with CRM tools, MS Office, and basic sales reporting is advantageous.
* Proactive, goal\-oriented mindset with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Business Development Executive- B2B
description:
**1\. Role Purpose** 




 This is a high\-ownership, individual\-contributor sales role focused on identifying, pitching, and converting new manufacturer and brand clients onto the AppointDistributors.com platform. The person will own the complete new\-client acquisition cycle — from prospecting to onboarding — and is expected to be a self\-driven closer, not just a lead follow\-up executive.
 



**2\. What Success Looks Like** 




 •    New client acquisition targets are met or exceeded every month with a healthy, well\-qualified pipeline.
 



 •    Leads are contacted, pitched, and followed up within agreed SLAs with no leakage.
 



 •    Client onboarding (profile, listing, category tagging) is completed accurately and promptly after every conversion.
 



 •    CRM records are current, complete, and reflect true lead/client status at all times.
 



 •    Client communication is professional, brand\-aligned, and builds trust from the first interaction.
 



 •    Revenue from new client acquisition grows consistently month over month.
 



**3\. Key Responsibilities – Prospecting \& Lead Generation** 




 •    Identify and build a pipeline of prospective manufacturers/brands seeking distributor networks across assigned categories/regions.
 



 •    Work assigned inbound leads (website inquiries, ads, referrals) as well as self\-sourced outbound leads.
 



 •    Research target companies and decision\-makers to personalize outreach and improve connect rates.
 



 •    Maintain a steady daily/weekly outreach volume (calls, email, WhatsApp) in line with targets.
 



**4\. Key Responsibilities – Client Pitching \& Conversion** 




 •    Pitch platform membership plans (registration, premium listings, lead access) clearly and persuasively.
 



 •    Understand each prospect's requirement — product category, budget, target region — and position the right plan.
 



 •    Handle objections, pricing negotiations, and follow\-ups professionally to close conversions.
 



 •    Coordinate with the reporting manager on pricing exceptions or non\-standard deal terms.
 



 •    Meet individual monthly acquisition, conversion, and revenue targets.
 



**5\. Key Responsibilities – Onboarding \& Handover** 




 •    Set up new client company profiles, product listings, and category tagging accurately upon conversion.
 



 •    Ensure all onboarding documentation and payment/registration formalities are completed without delay.
 



 •    Brief the new client on how to use the platform, respond to leads, and get the most value from their plan.
 



 •    Hand over onboarded clients to the EC (Existing Client) Division with complete, documented context.
 



**6\. Key Responsibilities – CRM, Reporting \& Coordination** 




 •    Maintain accurate, real\-time CRM records of every lead, follow\-up, conversion, and lost\-deal reason.
 



 •    Share regular pipeline and conversion reports with the reporting manager.
 



 •    Coordinate with the marketing team on lead quality, source performance, and campaign feedback.
 



 •    Flag recurring objections or market feedback that could inform pricing, product, or marketing decisions.
 



**7\. Required Competencies** 




 •    Strong ownership mindset with a genuine drive to hit and exceed sales targets.
 



 •    Excellent verbal and written communication in Hindi and English.
 



 •    Confident, persistent, and comfortable with outbound/cold outreach.
 



 •    Good listening and needs\-assessment ability to pitch the right plan to the right prospect.
 



 •    Basic CRM and Excel/Google Sheets proficiency.
 



 •    High follow\-up discipline and ability to manage a multi\-stage pipeline independently.
 


* •    Resilience to handle rejection and sustain performance in a target\-driven environment.
